patch_description: This redesign separates graph sanitization, multicast planning, exact directed-Steiner optimization, fallback routing, and topology serialization into focused components. For manageable destination sets, it uses a dynamic-programming directed Steiner tree solver to minimize the cost of the union of broadcast edges rather than independently paying for each destination path. This substantially reduces redundant cloud transfers while preserving parallel partition output. Larger destination sets use a shared-frontier fallback that still favors existing broadcast branches.
